subject.title: Add first-class page blocks transition proof

question: Should the generic store starter adopt the first-class Pages layout and manual migration path after its standalone legacy-block conversion is corrected?
rationale: This adds a persistent content-model and operator migration surface beyond a narrow bug fix, so maintainers need to confirm that it belongs in the reusable default.

options.title: Adopt after correction
options.body: Fix the standalone legacy-block conversion and land the layout transition as the starter's supported composition path.

options.title: Retain Portable Text defaults
options.body: Keep the existing Portable Text composition as the generic starter default and use the work only as external transition proof.

recommendation.title: Adopt after correction
recommendation.body: Fix the standalone legacy-block conversion and land the layout transition as the starter's supported composition path.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the proposed transition and are the only concrete routing candidate in the admitted history.
